evidence.name: Screen field: Inner spacing around the label
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Inner spacing around the label" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Inner spacing around the label
sections.description: Sets the breathing room between the label or icon and the button's edges, set separately for top, bottom, left, and right. More padding makes the button bigger and easier to tap; too little makes it look cramped. Generous top and bottom padding gives a primary button a comfortable, finger-friendly tap area.
